story.text: This work was built in recorded sessions, each with its decisions on the record: the contracts freeze and the one semantic decision (FD-1); the runtime auditors; the engine, where filling one stub exposed and fixed the Σ inversion; the apps; the pooling act; the hosting; this guide.

Two discoveries worth naming: the canary's determinant recompute caught the matrix carrying separations where correlations belonged — the strict test built to catch exactly that did. And the project turned out to have carried the name [[Kyra Gate]] since it was christened — KY-A keeps the name of the balanced sovereign persona the engine descends from.
The chronicle index is `docs/chronicles/README.md`. Every open question sits at the operator's door, listed, never buried.
